service.description: Comms Home for the current user. cardList: the counters, each {key, title, value, icon, link}: one per mail account with its unread Inbox mail, Messages (internal), Flagged, Snoozed (back by the end of today), Mentions and Not sent (sends that failed). needsReplyList, followUpList, meetingList, mailboxList and roomList: the lists, ten at most. hasMailAccount is false until the user has a mail account; problemAccountList names the accounts whose sign-in or sync failed, with canManage (only a manager fixes one). failedParts names what could not be read.

Internal, for get#CommsHome: the user's open follow-up calls and emails (tasks of the purposes WepPhoneCall and WepEmail on which the user is a party, not declined or unassigned) due within a week or overdue, the soonest first, ten at most.

Internal, for get#CommsHome and the meetings-source provider: the user's events from now (or fromDate) through the next two days (or thruDate) that have not ended (mantle.work.EventServices.get#FullCalendarData for the user's party: their calendars and the events they are on, declined ones left out), the soonest first, limit (ten) at most, each with its join link (the event's link, else the first web address in its location or description).

The meetings-source provider of IronStone's Comms root (plans/Comms-Framework.md W3): the user's meetings from fromDate through thruDate (get#HomeMeetings over their calendar), each with its title, when, its join link and its event's page, for the Calls screen's Meetings.
